case1_empty_page.notes: Handles cleanly without crashing; produces 0 blocks

case2_corrupt_pdf.error_message: Failed to load document (PDFium: Data format error).

case3_rotated_page.notes: Without orientation normalization, sideways text causes OCR failure or word scrambling

case4_low_resolution.notes: Tiny fonts / low resolution result in near-zero character recognition

case5_multi_column.notes: Pure horizontal projection / line grouping merges lines horizontally across column gutters if vertical coordinates overlap

case6_table.notes: Tables are linearized into standard paragraph blocks rather than structured grid/cells

case7_multilingual.notes: EasyOCR initialized with ['en'] only. Non-Latin scripts (Devanagari) are dropped or rendered as gibberish without explicit language config

case10_large_doc.notes: CPU-bound sequential OCR scales linearly with page count (~2-4s per page on CPU)
